papers.headline: LSST and Keck characterization of outer Main Belt comet P/2026 N2
papers.summary: We characterize comet P/2026 N2, whose outer Main Belt orbit has a=3.07 au, e=0.21, and i=2.25^°, using optical observations, archival imaging, and dynamical integrations. Observations from the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) at NSF-DOE Vera C.
papers.title: LSST and Keck characterization of outer Main Belt comet P/2026 N2

papers.headline: Chemical Demographics of Star-forming Regions
papers.summary: Our understanding of complex organic chemistry during the formation of stars and planets is shaped by a handful of cherry-picked sources with bright molecular emission lines.
papers.title: Chemical Demographics of Star-forming Regions

papers.headline: Dark Matter in the Galaxy: Insights from the Dynamics of Stellar Streams
papers.summary: Dark matter constitutes most of the matter in the Universe, yet its fundamental nature and distribution remain poorly understood.
papers.title: Dark Matter in the Galaxy: Insights from the Dynamics of Stellar Streams
